__broaden__.τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’
__broaden__.ἀμείνω: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); fem. acc. sg., contracted from ἀμείνονα, with ὀμίχλην · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’better’
__broaden__.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
__broaden__.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adj., agreeing with τείχεα: ’sacred (walls)’
__broaden__.ὁμοίϊον: ὁμοίϊος — alike, common to all, the same for all (sense not certain); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γῆρας; related to ὅμοιος · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νεῖκος: ’the same for all’
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’)
